entries.name: Catch-up (stick-slip)
entries.summary: The bet that a quiet stock catches up with its linked stocks. Over 2024 to 2026 the pull of linked stocks did not predict a quiet stock's later move (its t-values, a measure of how clearly an effect stands out from chance, were −0.7 and −0.8; 3.0 was needed), and the real map beat 7 of 20 maps with shuffled links (19 were needed).
